title: fix(security)!: app-automation elevation does not change or delete an append-only object's rows
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing: a system flow's, a system hook's and an action body's update or delete of a managedBy 'append-only' object is refused at run time)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:以系统身份运行的应用自动化(`runAs: 'system'` 的流程、`runAs: 'system'` 的钩子、动作脚本体)不能再修改或删除 `managedBy: 'append-only'` 对象(审计日志、动态流及同类账本)的记录,返回 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`。
- 为什么改:账本记录"发生过什么",只应由拥有它的平台服务写入;按维护者裁决(#32004 上的裁决记录 6787890900),应用自动化的提权不越过这条线。
- 风险与回滚:应用若用系统流程/钩子/动作改写或删除账本行,会从成功变为失败;本仓与 HotCRM 普查未发现此类写法。平台自身写入者(保留期清理、迁移、审计封存等)不受影响。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/flow-system-identity-write-refusal.ts`(新增的判断函数,复用身份写入拒绝的同一谓词)、`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`(调用点,位于系统短路之前)、`packages/services/service-automation/src/runas-system-append-only-write-refusal.integration.test.ts`(真实流程的端到端钉子与对照)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation exec vitest run src/runas-system-append-only-write-refusal.integration.test.ts`,预期 6 个用例全部通过(4 个拒绝 + 2 个对照)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule: **app-authored automation's system elevation does not change or delete the rows of an append-only object.**

- `plugin-security` `flow-system-identity-write-refusal.ts`: `assertAppAutomationAppendOnlyWriteAllowed` refuses an `update`, `transfer`, `delete`, `purge` or `restore` of an object whose registered schema declares `managedBy: 'append-only'`, from a context the identity-assignment refusal's predicate names (`elevationSource`: `isSystem` AND (`flowRunId` OR the app-automation mark)). No second predicate. The bucket is read off the live registry, and only once the context is such an elevation.
- `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`: the check sits beside the identity refusal, ahead of the `isSystem` short-circuit.
- The answer is the identity refusal's: `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403, with a message naming the operation, the object, the source and the rule. No new error code.
- `spec` `flow.zod.ts`: the `runAs` description states the rule; the flow reference pages are regenerated from it.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` row 25 states the rule.

Unchanged: reads of append-only objects from the same automation; its writes to every other object, and the audit and activity rows the platform records for them; the platform's own writers, whose system context carries neither a flow run nor the mark.

## Tests

Test names state the rule.

- `plugin-security` `flow-system-identity-write-refusal.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe`: the predicate over every judged verb, from a flow (user-triggered and user-less), a hook and an action elevation, on two append-only objects; the bucket read off the schema and never the name; a platform writer, a de-elevated run or mark, reads and other objects pass, and no schema is asked for a context that is not judged; through the real middleware on a real engine, update and delete refused with the store unmoved; CONTROL, a platform writer updates and deletes both ledgers, and the same elevations still read them and write an ordinary object.
- `runtime` `app-automation-identity-write-refusal.integration.test.ts`, a new top-level `describe`: a `runAs: 'system'` hook (sandboxed body and in-process handler), an app-authored hook's inherited system context and its `ctx.api.sudo()`, and an action body through `ctx.api` and `ctx.engine`: update and delete on two append-only objects refused, row unmoved. CONTROL: the same body reads both ledgers and updates and deletes an ordinary object; a hook registered in code writes a ledger row under an app-authored hook's write; a platform writer updates and deletes both ledgers.
- `service-automation` `runas-system-append-only-write-refusal.integration.test.ts` (new): a real `runAs: 'system'` flow's `update_record` and `delete_record` on the real `sys_audit_log` and `sys_activity` (AuditPlugin), user-triggered and user-less, on rows of two organizations: refused, rows unmoved. CONTROL: a platform system context updates and deletes both; the same flow reads both and creates an ordinary record, and the audit writer records that create in both ledgers.

## Acceptance notes

- A publish-time lint for this rule is not in this PR: the platform's append-only objects are not visible to `@objectstack/lint`, which reads the stack and `@objectstack/spec` only. Where that set should come from is with the seat.
- A cascade leg an elevated automation's own delete sets off on an append-only object is that automation's write, as for the identity refusal.
